master_output.idea:
Core idea: Introduce a dual-forward consistency loss where the model is trained to produce stable predictions between two stochastic forward passes (via dropout) of the same input, regularizing feature learning through architectural perturbations.

Non-trivial crux: Balancing the consistency term's weight against the primary loss to prevent underfitting in early epochs, while leveraging dropout's stochasticity to create meaningful perturbations that improve generalization without doubling training time.
